about:
devtools/measure.sh df-lowstack-compile [--backend cuda|hip]   a compiler
    devtools/measure.sh df-lowstack [--backend cuda|hip]           timed

declared.question: which DF classes the low-stack gate must cover; the open one is the unrolled (dd|g), 15,992 B of sm_86 stack by hand, over #606's ~14 KB
declared.rule: per class and form, over both arches: a class's UNROLLED form is admissible when its stack is at most STACK_BUDGET_B = 14,000 B on sm_86 and on gfx1200 and its compile finishes within COMPILE_BUDGET_S = 300 s on both. Every class whose unrolled form is not admissible must be under the gate (the acceptance: every class through (ff|i) / (i|i) at <= ~14 KB, and the user's 5-minute compile budget). A class whose unrolled form IS admissible stays unrolled unless the clock says the low-stack form is 'faster' (median low / unrolled below 1 - BAND = 0.95) on both cards. The gate is then the smallest of the module's rule shapes (an L floor, an E-block bound) that covers every class so marked and no admissible class the clock does not move; where none does, the shape is widened, never the budget
declared.expected: the unrolled (dd|g) is not admissible on sm_86 (15,992 B by hand), so the E-block arm tightens below (dd|g)'s; the low-stack form is slower than the unrolled one where both fit, as V's and DQ's were at the mixed f classes (#586)
declared.clock: per class: median over every timed launch of both forms in the same rounds, 'faster' / 'slower' / 'neutral' at BAND; a record, ruled on only as above

gate_at_measurement: every row's `default` is the gate it was measured under: eri3 and metric L >= 10 or E blocks over 1,785 doubles ((dd|g)'s)
decision: by `declared`: the unrolled (dd|g) is not admissible (15,992 B of sm_86 stack > 14,000 B), so eri3's E_DOUBLES_MAX moved to (pf|g)'s 1,575, the largest admissible unrolled class (13,928 B sm_86, 9,412 B gfx1200), gating (dd|g) and nothing else. The clock moves nothing: the low-stack form is 'slower' at every class timed on both cards (1.46x to 4.58x), so every admissible unrolled class stays. The metric's bound stays 1,785 (its largest unrolled class, (g|h), is 4,944 B / 5,320 B); measure_df_lowstack.test_the_gate_is_what_the_measured_rows_rule holds the gate to it
